author: FunkShard
body:
Why was I banned! I wasn't hacking I was using a button on my mouse because I have RSI (Repetitive Strain Injury) to attack instead of clicking rapidly, because it will destroy the muscle in my hand. I don't know if this looks suspicious but I think I can slow down the amount of clicks per second. I don't really understand why I was banned. I would have liked a warning to tell me if what I was doing was wrong. But from what I have seen in the rules it is not forbidden to use buttons on your mouse to attack. Please respond I love this server and I would hate to be permanently banned from it when I didn't do anything out of my knowledge that was wrong.

-FunkShard
